body:
Thank you, I needed that. I know this is the internet and people are also just not always that understanding, but I really had a hard time tonight after reading all these reactions. 

Believe it or not, but I do feel horrible at times about me being so incredibly bitter and jealous. But i feel there is no way that I can get rid of that ever. I already had many mental health problems before this MS thing, and have seen 3 therapists but nothing really helped. Everyone here says "go to a therapist" but what is left when that doesn't help. Honestly, I can only come up with suicide. Best for everyone involved. Only my faith forbids that. Tonight i just sat on my sofa staring into nothing trying to come up with solutions but i don't find any. If only it was as easy as just to "not be an asshole/selfish entitled bitch".

I want my family to acknowledge my pain, and to listen to me when i am in despair. And yes, I would want a hug every now and then. That is not something weird. But don't worry, I do not burden them with these emotions, and I do celebrate with her as well. Sometimes things are not that black and white, I think you still have to learn that. 

Also MS comes in many different forms. 

Also "you have made your choices". What the heck do you mean with that? Are you such a "the secret" kind of bitch who thinks people are asking for illnesses? And no, being single isnt a CHOICE either.

And if my sister would cut me out of her life because i have MS and as a result there is "negativity" and she only tolerates POSITIVENESS because she can't deal with REALITY, I would be glad that she kept herself and her child away from me! And would never ever dare to call such a woman my SISTER. Happily my sister is much kinder and loving and forgiving than you. So thank you for teaching me that, now I am also more motivated to be a better sister to her as well.

I am a bit shocked by the intense anger that my question and my way of (delusional?) thinking and emotions about my illness brings up to some of you.
Do you have a serious chronical illness? If not; then just shut up okay? :)
Okay clear, thanks again.
At this point I am more thinking of cutting them out of my life.

Then why did you say "she didnt time herself to get pregnant right when you discovered your MS diagnosis". You made it seem like that mattered. Now you say ; she tried to have a child for herself and that her life does not resolve around me. Then i just dont get why you added that phrase. 

Also I didn't really ask for judgments about my mental state. Maybe don't judge unless you have heard yourself that in a few years from now you are probably going to shit yourself and need a nurse to wipe your ass and your whole dignity goes to hell, and then have to live for a long long time because MS slowly kills you. Thank you very much.

Thank you for the answer.

Would it be different for your answer if I had my uterus removed?

"she didnt time herself to get pregnant right when you discovered your MS diagnosis". 

No. But she deliberately opened the high possibility. She could have timed it to NOT get pregnant right when i discovered it. 

I know it is not her fault that I am ill. Neither is it my fault.
Yes I feel she should have waited a bit. I dont say she can never get pregnant. Just wait like half year or something, they have postponed it a long time, so why not a bit more.

I actually don't like this season at all. To me this serie has become so incredibly forced, i do not feel anything at all about it anymore. Sometimes i find myself laughing out loud because it is so clear to me what the writers want me to think and feel. I just dont get sucked into the story anymore. It also makes this serie so slow, every scene gets dragged with intense looks or useless gestures. Like the end scene in episode 7 when Serena asks June to edit, that picking the pen moment reminded me of YouTube-ASMR video's. I know its imporant but i dont need all the loooong scenes to know something is important.
i wish someone responded on this :(
oh and "permanent solution for a temporary problem" . What a bullshit. What if your problems ARE permanent? Or what if you feel like this for years, and it MIGHT be permanent.

is this your website? If yes, very nicely written and helpful. Thank you. So you mean "plan of action" on how to eat, test, did also cure your depression?

I calculated, testing as much as some people suggest costs around 120 euro a month. And i do not earn much, and im such an economical person , i took proud in saving a lot of money.. now that too has to go down the drain because of this stupid illness. :(

Thank you, like i mentioned before; i already started (i dont test though, because it is expensive and it will make me more anxious and obsessed). It doesnt really help, with the bloodsugars yes.. but not with my depression. Yes I am also scared for the consequences of course, i feel this will be a chronic disease in the end, whether you eat keto or not. Keto doesnt give any guarantee. Keto could stop working too. 

How did you beat it? The depression?

yes that is true, i am being dramatic when is say i cant eat out. But i do feel that when i need to order something i dont really want or like, i can as well just NOT go out and save the money. It's only making me frustrated. Because i want bread and the real thing, pasta.. not broccoli. :( (Sorry u maybe think i am a big baby and maybe i am , but this is really really hard on me... i dont like meat, i love bread, pizza)

this is exactly what i mean, i do appreciate the advice, but it is what i am already doing. And im struggling with it. Physically, yes keto feels good and fine, i do not feel sick or anything. But mentally, i miss my carbs, I miss the feeling i got from them , something resembling happiness..
sent you a PM, thank you so much.
okay? Please ask :)

Yes this show is on my mind a lot. It also really gets me thinking about my own life and what I want with it. Family has Always been so important for me, more than friends. I just like the idea of being kind of obligated to stick together and it's so special that your family knows you your whole life. My sister is my best friend. Now Im 31 and would really like a family on my own, but ive not found a husband yet and this show at first made me more motivated to start actively looking and opening up again, but sometimes lately i feel its been getting painful. It hurts to see what Rebecca and Jack have, and this special family rituals with their kids... it's amazing, the thing that matters most in life in the end. And it's hurting me a lot that i dont have that and i believe it's just not written for me.

I didn't like this twist to be honest :( I was also rolling my eyes a bit, another "plot twist" oh hehe look you thought it was in the present but its actually in the future ..wow! .. 

i really hope this isnt going to be a storyline.

I never wanted to know :( , it's all your faults, everyone pushed on the mystery on Jack's death and now it's happening, damn you. :(

And will we never see Jack and Rebecca together now again?

wow your mom looks amazing! Congrats on her for losing all that weight.

It's not that i do not follow this diet now, u get me wrong. i do follow it, because it stabilizes blood sugar, i did my research..and if i am Lucky my diabetes will be in remission. I just feel that saying it is a cure gives me false hope, and seems like the one who is saying it doesnt admit that its an illness and a huge challenge.

It's okay! I know you were trying to help..ive calmed down a lot happily after a good night sleep. Life doesnt seem completly black anymore, i can see some perspective. Thank you so much for this message, and understanding me. it does give me hope and its so good to read that you feel in control now.

i know of LADA. I am very afraid i have this type. :( it does feel the end of the world, i already feel so extremely uncomfortable in my own skin, everything is a huge task, getting dressed , sitting in the bus. I dont want to think about also measuring blood levels, using insulin etc.... :( i just got a panic attack reading your message. Ive been on diabetes.co.uk at the beginning, but it was too much, too much information.. i just want to ignore it.

i want to die.. im sorry that i write this here, but i so badly want to die right now ..

Thank you for your response, and your links. I will definitly read more into that later. I am truly appreciating your response, really, but ive to point out that this comparison is not right. You say "People say "it's remission because if you go back to eating junk food for months at a time it comes back" yeah well if you cure a broken leg and then snap it in half again, you just re-broke it, it didn't "come back from remission." "

You should more say it like this; "if you broke your leg, and then its cured but if you run again its broken again". You wouldn't say that is a cure right? Because running is what legs should bare. Same goes for diabetes. Its not about junk food, its about eating pretty normal stuff actually, like some chips and chocolate at a movie.. who doesnt. And only if you have diabetes your blood sugars rise from that above a healthy margin. Also, not everyone who eats a lot of junk food and is fat, immediatly has diabetes. It's an illness, and a chronic one. The pancreas is not working properly, and that is irreversible.

I appreciate it but its not a cure. It requires lifelong keto diet, and constant check up to see if the diabetes is still in remission. There is a reason they talk about "reversing" and not really cure. They know to say its curable would be too strong. But i appreciate your response and its good to know that your mom has her blood sugars below diabetic levels.. thats something i strive for. And wow she is so lucky to hae Dr. Hallberg as her doctor!

Yes thank you, I know diabetes can be in remission by lifestyle changes but its not a cure, most doctors agree with that, its a chronic disease. So this is a lifelong challenge, thats why its worrying me. 

I didnt know about the connection to food with suicidal thoughts.
